transfer_readme: The settings of %s (%s), exported from Script Studio. Change only the "value" entries. Every key that starts with $ describes the setting beside it and is ignored on import, so leave those as they are. Keep every key of every row, hidden ones included, and keep rows in the order given where $row_labels is set. Rows are identified by their $merge_key or $auto_key; a row that ships with the script comes back if it is removed, so change its fields rather than its key. Keep each value the shape its $type says: positions are objects with x, y, z and heading; a color is #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa where $type is rgba; times are HH:MM; durations are whole seconds; a choice must be one of its $options, written with the same JSON type. A choice that names a row of another list must already be saved: import that list first, then the rest. Do not add or rename settings. Import the file back on the same page, under Import & Export.
transfer_repaired: The text was tidied to read it — comments, trailing commas or words around the file were ignored
transfer_restart: Restart %s so it picks up the updated library, then check again
transfer_save_failed: Could not write %s — use Copy instead
transfer_stale: Settings changed since this page was opened — refresh, then check again

transfer_unknown_one: %s setting is not known to this script and was ignored
